SIKAROOF® VERSIJACK® K SPACER TAB: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab, August 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sikaroof-versijackkspacertab.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab is an accessory used on top of adjustable pedestals to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of pavers in raised flooring systems. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has four breakable tabs to support four paver corners that rest on top of the adjustable pedestal.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® K and may be manufactured with tabs of various thicknesses to create varying drainage gaps sizes, to support concrete pavers, stone pavers, and porcelain tiles that have a minimum thickness of 20 mm.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Spacer tabs are used with adjustable pedestals for raised pavers flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SPACER TAB FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Consistent paver gaps
    - Promotes surface drainage
    - Eliminates efflorescence
    - Recyclable components
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
    - Operates within a wide service temperature range
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Black circular disc spacer tab
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Diameter: 118 mm
    - Height: Spacer Tab Height; 12 mm
    - Service temperature: - 30 ºC to 80 ºC
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
2.7 Packaging. SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab
    | 3x12 | 4x12 | 5x12 |
    | 6x12 | 8x12 | 10x12 |
    | Refer to pricelist |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.8 Storage conditions. Products must be stored in their original packing, in their original box, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Thickness. Spacer Tab Thickness
    | 3x12 | 4x12 | 5x12 |
    | 3 mm | 4 mm | 5 mm |
    | 6x12 | 8x12 | 10x12 |
    | 6 mm | 8 mm | 10 mm |
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab is not resistant to permanent weathering and UV exposure.
    For more information, please contact Sika Sales Personnel.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab, August 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sikaroof-versijackkspacertab.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
